name: volcengine-plugins
description: Independent Volcengine MCP tools for images, videos, enhancement and fine subtitle erasure.

interface.shortDescription: Seedream 生图、Seedance 视频、MediaKit 超分与精细化去字幕。
interface.longDescription: Independent wrapper for official Volcengine APIs: Seedream images, Seedance videos, MediaKit standard/generative enhancement, and standalone fine subtitle erasure with v5 Quality defaults. Includes source upload, offline preview, task query and unchanged result download. Existing reference-video workflow retained. Separate MediaKit credentials; no automatic paid retries or model fallback.
defaultPrompt: Check Volcengine image, video, enhancement and subtitle erasure capabilities and configuration.
Remove only hard subtitles with the fine v5 service; preview first and preserve audio and timing.
Plan a reference video with $reference-video-production before authorized generation.
